verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own RTX 5090 product page states the capacity and memory type: 32 GB of GDDR7. The 512-bit bus width appears only in Tom's Hardware's review, not in first-party published specs, and no source in the pack gives memory bandwidth. So the full spec set the story asks for is not shown as published. Missing for 10: first-party publication of bus width, any memory bandwidth figure.
